## 更新内容

- 新增 `technical-diagram` 技能，默认关闭；启用后可在技术方案正文生成、已有技术方案扩写中候选生成技术图谱。
- 在正文生成配置和继续扩写配置中加入“生成技术图谱”选项，并根据技能启用状态自动可用或禁用。
- 优化正文生成配置弹窗布局，配置项较多时中间区域滚动，底部操作按钮保持在弹窗内。
- 新增技术图谱 SVG 本地生成与 Word 导出支持，适合架构、拓扑、数据流、复杂流程和模块关系图。
- 修复技术图谱导出 Word 时 SVG 直接插入导致的 `undefined.type` 报错。
- 修复 SVG 转 PNG 时中文、节点文字、图例文字和箭头缺失的问题。
- 将客户端版本号更新至 `0.7.3`。

## 注意事项

- Mermaid 图仍通过 `mermaid.ink` 转换，导出速度会受网络影响。
- 技术图谱导出会在本地转换为 PNG 后插入 Word，已减少对远程服务和 Word SVG 兼容性的依赖。

## What's Changed

- Added the new `technical-diagram` skill, disabled by default. When enabled, it participates in technical plan generation and existing-plan expansion.
- Added a visible “Generate Technical Diagram” option in both full content generation settings and expansion settings, gated by the skill state.
- Improved the content generation settings modal so long settings scroll inside the dialog while action buttons stay visible.
- Added local SVG generation and Word export support for technical diagrams, covering architecture, topology, data-flow, complex process, and module relationship diagrams.
- Fixed Word export failures caused by passing SVG images directly to `docx`, which could trigger an `undefined.type` error.
- Fixed missing Chinese text, labels, legends, and arrowheads when converting technical diagram SVGs to PNG for Word export.
- Updated the client version to `0.7.3`.

## Notes

- Mermaid diagrams are still converted through `mermaid.ink`, so export speed may depend on network availability.
- Technical diagrams are converted locally to PNG before being inserted into Word, reducing reliance on remote services and Word SVG compatibility.
